status: proposed for Gate 3 owner review; not adopted
units: second homes on single-family lots (ADU-type calibration) per 1,000 one-unit detached homes per year

lower.basis: Madison floor: observed 2022-2025 rate 0.183 / 0.8 (AQ-024, AQ-029, G2-9); no spillover; California restrictive-group ramp (no slower ramp observed)

central.basis: California restrictive group after the 2020 package, 2023-2025 plateau 1.23 [0.70-2.01]; ramp from the same group, capped at 1 in year 5; spillover x2.39 for benchmark places (California permissive group)

upper.basis: Owner's ADU-share model: California ADU-to-BPS ratio 0.292 applied to Wisconsin BPS 2023-2025 (3.75 [2.76-4.81]); faster middle-group ramp, capped at 1; spillover x3.05 (California permissive group without Los Angeles)
